Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

import java.util.Scanner;

public class MaxOfThree {

	public static void maxi( int a ,int b, int c)
	{
		if(a>b&& a>c)
			System.out.println("The greatest value is " +a);
		else if(a<b && b>c)
			System.out.println("The greatest value is " +b);
		else if (c>a && c>b)
			System.out.println("The greatest value is " +c);
	}
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		
		Scanner s = new Scanner(System.in);
		System.out.println("Enter 3 numbers:");
		int a= s.nextInt();
		int b= s.nextInt();
		int c= s.nextInt();
		maxi(a,b,c);

	}

}
